body:
> Injection of hits is handled by Composition now: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/managing-results/compositions/smart-groups/

We're specifically interested in injecting advertising banners, ideally from our CMS rather than via custom JSON in Algolia.

After having a quick skim of the Composition docs the feature seems mainly to be used for injecting hits/results from the same index? Is that accurate? If so, do you have a recommendation for handling banners in React InstantSearch 7?
